profile.name: Feng
profile.overview: Feng Wei is, in a word, unconventional. Whatever he lacks in traditional Tekken tools, he makes up for it with incredible evasion, a full kit of very frustrating lows, and a great suite of back turn tools, including a 50/50 coin-flip throw mixup. His crouch dash (qcf or d,df) gives him the ability to make deep approaches by canceling into his safe ws1 (d,df,n,1) and also gives him access to his qcf+1+2 and qcf+1. The former is a +0 on block headbutt that forces the opponent into crouch. The latter is a low, unparryable shoulder. Both wreak havoc on counter hit.
profile.playstyle: Unconventional and evasive. Control neutral with great jabs, mid pokes (b+4, df+1) and many lows, dodge with evasive moves, and mix the opponent up from Kenpo (KNP), Shifting Clouds (STC) and back-turned. Wavu notes he is weak to sidesteps and sidewalks to his left.
strengths: Strong neutral control with great jabs, mid pokes (b+4, df+1) and low pokes (d+2, db+3, FC.df+4,1)
Highly evasive with moves like uf+2, b,f+1, and qcf+1, and stances like Deceptive Step
Can keepout in a pinch with f+4 and get big whiff punishes with moves like KNP 3, f+3,4 or df+3
Very good wall carry on combos even with instant tornados
Tricky extended movelist can throw opponents off guard
Heat temporarily makes his b+1 knock down for more damage, and gives him a lockdown mid (3+4) into backturn as well as a guard break
weaknesses: Wonky range and hitbox on his hopkick and ws3 can make it hard to launch punish some specific moves
Big lows are locked to stance or clean hit
Heat Smash is among the slowest in the game at i20
The oldest 27 year old man of all time

keyMoves.summary: Stunning Palm: i14 mid, +0 on block, +36g on counter hit.
keyMoves.use: To check ducking and keep neutral.

keyMoves.summary: Fish Hook: i12 mid, -10 on block.
Iron Palm: i10 high, launches on counter hit (+36a). -12 on block.
keyMoves.avoid: -12 on block; it is a high.

keyMoves.summary: Soaring Eagle: i15 launcher, -13 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His i15 launch punisher; launches crouchers too (Wavu).

keyMoves.summary: Bow Kick: i15 while-standing launcher, -12 on block.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Punish lows; Wavu notes its range can be awkward.

keyMoves.summary: Rising Heel Kick: i11 while-standing mid, -7 on block.
Adamantine Uppercut: i15 while-standing mid, -7 on block, tornado on counter hit.
keyMoves.use: Out of crouch when they press.

keyMoves.summary: Heavy Hammer: i20 low, -12 on block.
Piercing Arrow: i17 low, -15 on block; becomes a throw on front counter hit.
keyMoves.purpose: A quick low with a CH reward.

keyMoves.summary: Iron Fortress: i13 mid Heat Engager, -19 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His i13 punisher and Heat start.

keyMoves.summary: Fei He Zhang: i14 high from Kenpo, Heat Engager.
Serpent Slayer: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2.

combos.name: Off-axis launch: f+4,2 T! uf+3 db+1,2,4
combos.situation: After an off-axis launch such as uf+4 (Wavu: 48 damage).
mistakes: Using this route when the opponent is straight in front: it is for off-axis launches.
